scenarios.name: Select a solid feature in the browser

scenario_steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a single block created by an extrusion
the model browser shows the extrusion and its nested sketch
the user selects the extrusion row in the model browser
the visible block edges are highlighted in blue
a contextual toolbar appears over the model
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the blue edge highlighting and contextual toolbar disappear
